content.user_title: Assess Data Compliance Across the Full Lifecycle
content.value_statement: Organizations can miss legal duties across data collection, use, sharing, export, trading, and security. This skill structures assessments, risk classifications, controls, and audit deliverables.
actual_capabilities: Reviews eight compliance areas across data classification, personal information, sourcing, processing, sharing, export, trading, and security.
Classifies findings into four risk levels with recommended response priorities.
Drafts structures for compliance assessments, classification tables, audit reports, and remediation plans.
Designs governance controls across policies, accountable roles, technical measures, and evidence retention.
Provides workflows for due diligence, audits, incident response, training, and regulatory preparation.
limitations: The skill focuses on Chinese data compliance frameworks and may not fit other jurisdictions.
It does not replace advice from licensed counsel, regulators, auditors, or accredited assessors.
Legal requirements, thresholds, and standards may change after the knowledge base date.
Reliable conclusions require current facts, data inventories, contracts, system records, and implementation evidence.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Compliance Baseline
use_cases.description: Map data activities, identify missing evidence, and create a prioritized four-level risk register.

use_cases.title: Classify Enterprise Data
use_cases.description: Structure a data classification exercise and distinguish core, important, general, personal, and sensitive personal information.

use_cases.title: Plan Audit Remediation
use_cases.description: Convert audit observations into owners, deadlines, required evidence, and verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Compliance Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data activity: [describe activity]. Identify applicable compliance areas, missing facts, likely risks, and immediate next steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an initial review of one data processing activity.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Data Classification Table
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a classification table for [data inventory]. Include category, sensitivity, legal status, processing purpose, access scope, retention, and supporting evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when organizing an enterprise data inventory.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Four-Level Risk Register
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [business process] across all eight compliance areas. Produce four-level findings with evidence, legal basis, impact, owner, action, deadline, and validation method.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a structured compliance assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Audit and Remediation Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an audit program for [organization]. Cover scope, interviews, sampling, controls, evidence, legal updates, findings, remediation governance, and final quality checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced organization-wide compliance engagement.

output_examples.input: Assess a customer analytics project that combines account records with mobile location data.
output: High risk: The purpose and necessity of location processing require documented review.
Required evidence: Data inventory, privacy notice, consent records, access logs, retention schedule, and vendor agreements.
Next action: Pause expanded use until the lawful basis, minimization, and sensitive information controls are verified.

output_examples.input: Outline a compliance audit for a company preparing a data transaction.
output: Scope: Data source, ownership documents, personal information, important data, export exposure, security controls, and transaction terms.
Method: Review documents, interview accountable roles, sample records, test control evidence, and classify findings.
Deliverables: Audit report, four-level risk register, remediation plan, and evidence checklist.

output_examples.input: Create a remediation entry for missing data retention controls.
output_examples.output: Medium risk: Retention periods are not consistently defined. Assign policy and system owners, approve schedules, configure deletion controls, and retain test evidence.

best_practices: Provide current business facts, data flows, systems, vendors, jurisdictions, contracts, and existing control evidence.
Validate every conclusion against current laws, official standards, industry rules, and qualified professional advice.
Assign each remediation action an owner, deadline, evidence requirement, and independent verification step.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated assessments as final legal opinions or regulatory approvals.
Do not conclude compliance from written policies without testing execution records and technical controls.
Do not share unnecessary personal, sensitive, confidential, or regulated data in prompts.

faq.question: Which compliance areas does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers classification, personal information, sourcing, processing, sharing, export, trading, and data security.

faq.question: Can it provide a final legal opinion?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured analysis and drafts that require review by qualified legal and compliance professionals.

faq.question: What information improves an assessment?
faq.answer: Provide data inventories, flow diagrams, purposes, legal bases, notices, contracts, retention rules, security controls, and implementation evidence.

faq.question: Does it support data classification?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure classification tables for core, important, general, personal, and sensitive personal information.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare scope, evidence requests, interview topics, testing steps, finding formats, and remediation plans.

faq.question: How should legal updates be handled?
faq.answer: Verify all laws, thresholds, standards, and regulator guidance against current official sources before relying on an output.
